This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You oversee the production process and, together with your team, ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

You monitor the operation of 3 automatic packaging machines

 
• 
You manage 3 operators and 2 forklift drivers and provide guidance throughout their work

 
• 
You actively work on the machines yourself and step in wherever needed

 
• 
You set up, monitor, and adjust the packaging machines

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, safety, efficiency, and production planning

 
• 
You carry out checks on products and packaging

 
• 
You identify malfunctions and deviations and resolve them yourself whenever possible

 
• 
You ensure an efficient distribution of tasks and clear communication within the team

 
• 
You are the first point of contact for employees on the production floor

• 
Experience working with an automatic packaging line is essential

 
• 
You have strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality

 
• 
Experience with CPS, multihead weighers, checkweighers, metal detection systems and/or automatic stackers is an advantage

 
• 
Experience managing or coordinating a team is an asset

 
• 
You have natural leadership skills and the maturity required to take responsibility

 
• 
You have good organisational and communication skills

 
• 
You communicate very well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is essential, as you will be managing operators and forklift drivers who speak Dutch, English, or French

Your day involves setting up machines, performing quality checks, and packaging products. You work in a shift system and actively contribute ideas for improvements.
Interested in joining an innovative team where you can grow? Apply now!

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Data & AI Impact Consultant Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Data Consultant, you are more than just an executor. You are a cornerstone of our Data & AI Business Unit - technically strong, but also driven to improve your colleagues, clients, and our approach every day.

Specifically:

• You design and build modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Data Fabric) with a focus on reusability and AI-readiness.

• You actively work on your own growth, but also help colleagues grow - through coaching, feedback, or knowledge sharing.

• You have a clear consultancy mindset: supported by (inter)national knowledge, references, and experience, you help our clients reach the next level. You are solution-oriented and leave every client smarter. You work with a partner mindset.

• You take initiative beyond projects to help build Inetum: in client development, talent growth, or community engagement - depending on your strengths.

We are looking for someone who recognizes themselves in this profile:

• You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics projects.

• A good knowledge of Dutch and English are mandatory, French is an asset.

• You are familiar with the Azure stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Storage, Purview, Functions) and/or Databricks.

• You think structurally and flexibly: you adapt easily to changing contexts and always seek value for the client.

• You are interested in AI and the role it plays in modern data products (prompt engineering, GenAI, monitoring, automation...).

• You create business impact and understand the outcomes of our work, not just the technical implementations.

• You want to be part of a team - not just participate, but help shape it.

Why join inetum?

• Impactful Career Growth: Work on strategic projects that shape the digital landscape of the public sector.

• Continuous Learning & Development: Access training and certification programs to expand your skills and stay ahead in the industry.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid working options, satellite offices, and a dynamic work environment.
